aloo-chaat.name: Aloo chaat
aloo-chaat.explainer: An Indian street-food snack of potatoes, fried or boiled until crisp, topped with yoghurt, tangy tamarind or mint chutney, spices and chickpeas.

bac-xiu.name: Bạc xỉu (iced Vietnamese milk coffee)
bac-xiu.explainer: A Vietnamese coffee made mostly of milk with a small amount of strong dark-roast coffee and sweetened condensed milk, usually served iced and stirred before drinking. Bạc means pale or silver in Vietnamese, which refers to how light the drink looks.

biryani.name: Biryani
biryani.explainer: A layered rice dish from South Asia where spiced meat or vegetables are cooked together with long-grain basmati rice, usually with saffron, fried onions and fresh herbs.

camaroes-ao-diabo.name: Camarões ao diabo (devil's shrimp)
camaroes-ao-diabo.explainer: Prawns cooked in a fiery sauce of chili, garlic and vinegar.

cheese-naan.name: Cheese naan
cheese-naan.explainer: A leavened flatbread from South Asia, baked against the hot walls of a tandoor or in a hot pan, with melted cheese inside or on top.

chicken-65.name: Chicken 65
chicken-65.explainer: Boneless chicken pieces marinated in spices, often with yogurt or ginger and garlic, then deep-fried until crisp and tossed with green chilies and curry leaves. It is a South Indian dish, popular as a spicy starter.

chicken-biryani.name: Chicken biryani
chicken-biryani.explainer: A layered rice dish from South Asia where spiced chicken is cooked together with long-grain basmati rice, usually with saffron, fried onions and fresh herbs.

chicken-burrito.name: Chicken burrito
chicken-burrito.explainer: A large flour tortilla wrapped around a filling of seasoned chicken, rice and beans, usually with cheese, salsa and other toppings, and eaten as a handheld meal.

chicken-cafreal.name: Chicken cafreal
chicken-cafreal.explainer: A Goan chicken dish marinated in a bright green paste of fresh coriander, green chilies, garlic and spices, then pan-fried.

chicken-shawarma.name: Chicken shawarma
chicken-shawarma.explainer: Marinated chicken stacked on a vertical spit and roasted slowly, then shaved off and served in flatbread or on a plate with pickles, garlic sauce and sometimes tahini.

chicken-soup.name: Desi chicken soup
chicken-soup.explainer: A light, brothy chicken soup from South Asia, often made with ginger, garlic, black pepper and whole spices, sometimes with a little lemon or fresh coriander on top. In Hindi and Urdu it is called shorba or yakhni.

chicken-tikka.name: Chicken tikka
chicken-tikka.explainer: Boneless chicken pieces marinated in yogurt, ginger, garlic and spices, then grilled in a tandoor or over charcoal until charred at the edges and juicy inside.

chicken-tikka-masala.name: Chicken tikka masala
chicken-tikka-masala.explainer: Pieces of chicken marinated in yogurt and spices, grilled, then served in a creamy, tomato-based sauce.

chipotle-burger.name: Chipotle Burger
chipotle-burger.explainer: A beef burger with cheddar, caramelised onions, jalapeños and a smoky, spicy chipotle sauce.

classic-fries.name: Classic fries
classic-fries.explainer: Potato cut into sticks and deep-fried until golden and crisp, then salted and served as a side.

deep-fried-chicken-tartar.name: Deep-fried chicken with tartar sauce
deep-fried-chicken-tartar.explainer: Japanese-style chicken pieces coated and deep-fried until crisp, then dipped in a sweet and sour nanban sauce and topped with tartar sauce, a mayonnaise-based sauce with pickles and herbs.

desi-grilled-chicken.name: Desi grilled chicken
desi-grilled-chicken.explainer: Chicken pieces marinated in yogurt and South Asian spices, then grilled over charcoal or fire until charred at the edges and juicy inside.

falafel.name: Falafel
falafel.explainer: Deep-fried balls or patties made from ground chickpeas or fava beans mixed with herbs and spices, usually served in pita or on a plate with tahini or salad.

frango-assado.name: Frango assado (Portuguese grilled chicken)
frango-assado.explainer: A Portuguese dish of whole chicken seasoned with garlic, paprika, wine and herbs, then roasted or grilled over charcoal or on a spit until the skin is crisp and the meat stays juicy. Often served with fries, rice or salad.

frango-desossado.name: Boneless chicken combo
frango-desossado.explainer: Chicken pieces with the bone removed, usually grilled or roasted and served with sides. Frango is the Portuguese word for chicken, and desossado means boneless.

fried-chicken-thighs.name: Fried chicken thighs
fried-chicken-thighs.explainer: Boneless or bone-in chicken thigh pieces coated in seasoned flour or batter and deep-fried until the outside is crisp and the meat inside stays juicy.

full-english-breakfast.name: Full English breakfast
full-english-breakfast.explainer: A cooked breakfast from England and the UK of eggs, bacon or sausage, baked beans, grilled tomato and mushrooms, usually served with toast.

grilled-chicken-plate.name: Grilled chicken plate
grilled-chicken-plate.explainer: Grilled chicken served with rice and fried potatoes, a common plate in Portuguese grill houses. Piri piri, a hot sauce made from African bird's-eye chilies with olive oil, garlic and lemon, is the usual condiment.
aliases: chicken thighs with rice and chips

jalapeno-poppers.name: Jalapeño poppers
jalapeno-poppers.explainer: Whole jalapeño chilies split open, filled with a soft cheese mixture, then breaded or battered and fried until crisp.

kadala-curry.name: Kadala curry
kadala-curry.explainer: A Kerala curry of black chickpeas simmered in a spiced coconut gravy, usually eaten with puttu, appam or dosa.

karaka-special.name: Karaka special
karaka-special.explainer: A spicy ramen bowl: Japanese wheat noodles in a broth heated with chili, usually finished with chili oil and topped with spiced minced pork or other savoury toppings.

korean-fried-chicken.name: Korean fried chicken
korean-fried-chicken.explainer: Chicken pieces coated in a thin, seasoned batter and fried until very crisp, often fried twice for a lighter, crackly crust, and served plain or with a sweet, spicy or garlicky glaze.

kukhura-ra-bholte-khursani.name: Kukhura ra bholte khursani (Nepali chicken with chilies)
kukhura-ra-bholte-khursani.explainer: Chicken pieces sautéed with onion, tomato, green pepper, ginger and chilies, forming a spicy, thick, stir-fry-style curry. In Nepali, kukhura means chicken and khursani means chili.

kukhurako-chhati-bhungroma.name: Kukhurako chhati bhungroma (chargrilled chicken breast)
kukhurako-chhati-bhungroma.explainer: Boneless chicken breast marinated in yogurt and spices, then chargrilled until charred at the edges and juicy inside. It is a Nepali-style grilled chicken, close to Indian chicken tikka. In Nepali, kukhurako chhati means chicken breast.

mangalorean-chicken.name: Mangalorean chicken
mangalorean-chicken.explainer: A chicken curry from the Mangalorean coast of Karnataka in southwest India, typically cooked in a spiced gravy with chilies, coconut and tamarind.

masala-dosa.name: Masala dosa
masala-dosa.explainer: A thin, crisp South Indian crepe made from a fermented rice and lentil batter, cooked on a hot griddle and folded around a spiced potato filling, usually served with coconut chutney and sambar.

minchi.name: Minchi
minchi.explainer: Macau's comfort dish: minced beef or pork stir-fried with soy sauce, onion and small cubes of fried potato, often topped with a fried egg and eaten with rice.

mustard-malai-broccoli.name: Mustard malai broccoli
mustard-malai-broccoli.explainer: Broccoli florets marinated in malai, a spiced cream mixture (malai means cream in Hindi) flavoured with mustard, then grilled until charred at the edges.

mutton-biryani.name: Mutton biryani
mutton-biryani.explainer: A layered rice dish from South Asia where spiced mutton, usually goat or lamb, is cooked together with long-grain basmati rice, usually with saffron, fried onions and fresh herbs.

old-delhi-butter-chicken.name: Old Delhi butter chicken
old-delhi-butter-chicken.explainer: Butter chicken, also called murgh makhani, is chicken cooked in a rich, creamy tomato and butter sauce spiced with garam masala, a dish most closely associated with North Indian and Delhi cooking.

pad-kra-pao.name: Pad kra pao
pad-kra-pao.explainer: A Thai stir-fry of minced meat, usually chicken, pork or beef, cooked with holy basil, garlic and chilies, and typically served over steamed rice.

scallops.name: Scallops
scallops.explainer: The meat of a sea scallop, a shellfish with a sweet, tender flesh that is usually seared or grilled quickly so the outside browns and the centre stays soft.

street-burger.name: Street Burger
street-burger.explainer: A smash burger is a ball of beef pressed flat on a very hot griddle so the edges turn crisp while the middle stays juicy, usually served in a soft bun with cheese, onions and pickles.

thin-crust-pizza.name: Thin crust pizza
thin-crust-pizza.explainer: A pizza with a thin, crisp base that bakes until the edges are crackly, with the sauce, cheese and toppings sitting on top rather than in a thick, bready crust.

tofu-fried-rice.name: Tofu fried rice
tofu-fried-rice.explainer: Steamed rice stir-fried in a hot wok with cubes or strips of tofu, egg or vegetables, garlic, soy sauce and spring onion, a simple everyday rice dish in Vietnamese and other East and Southeast Asian kitchens.

tom-yum-soup.name: Tom yum soup
tom-yum-soup.explainer: A hot and sour Thai soup flavoured with lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves and chilies, usually made with shrimp or chicken and mushrooms.
